mode: image2image (vanilla CSFF card art as style reference)
prompt:
Use the attached reference image as a style reference only: match its rendering exactly (flat posterized colour fills in a few hard-edged tonal steps like cel shading, no soft gradients, no watercolour bleed, no paper texture, thin dark ink outlines, small ink tick and hatch marks for feathers), its muted naturalistic palette and its realistic animal anatomy; do not copy its subject (no bear) or pose.
Subject: one realistic golden eagle alone, in flight, wings spread wide and slightly raised, seen from slightly below and to the side, head turned down looking at the ground, yellow hooked beak, golden-brown nape, dark brown body and wing feathers with paler bands, yellow legs with open curved black talons reaching downward, holding nothing. The eagle is the only thing in the picture: no prey, no hare, no other birds, no other animals, no people, no ground.
The eagle is the single subject, comfortably inset from every edge with generous white margin, isolated on a solid flat pure white background (#FFFFFF) that fills every edge of the frame, no cast shadow, no sky, no clouds, no scenery, no text, no watermark, no signature, no border, no frame.
Avoid: photo, photorealistic, 3D render, watercolour, soft airbrushed gradients, paper texture, anime, cartoon, cute, prey, hare, rabbit, partridge, second bird, flock, multiple animals, neon colours, lens flare, cropped wings, scenery behind the subject, sky, grey background, off-white background, drop shadow, checkerboard, transparency grid, text, watermark, signature, logo, border, frame.
note: Owner-approved 2026-10-10 in the Card Art Restyle Review (restyle toward vanilla card art). Finished by /process-card-art.
